editorial:
Imagine you are a private eye in LA who just wants a simple payday. You get hired to find a missing stripper, but things go south fast. Every person you talk to ends up dead, and suddenly you are caught in a wild game of cat and mouse. You will meet a scary Russian boxer, some loud cops, and a rich old man who is obsessed with a secret called the Big Bang. Along with his beautiful wife, these characters turn a basic missing person case into a dangerous road trip from the city to the desert. It feels like a classic detective story but with a much faster, more chaotic energy.

You will love how the mystery keeps you guessing, though some of the plot twists might feel a bit wild. The action is punchy and the pacing keeps you on your toes so you never get bored. While the story gets a bit messy toward the end, the ride is worth it for the suspense alone. It is a great pick for a weekend movie night when you want something exciting.
endingExplained: You discover that the mystery is actually about a huge amount of money and a secret that connects all the characters. After a lot of fighting and deaths, Cruz finds out the truth about the billionaire's plan. The Big Bang is not a science theory, but a massive payout. In the end, the bad guys are stopped, the money is sorted out, and Cruz survives the chaos to finally get his answers.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves detective stories with a twist.
